unexpected_findings_beyond_the_checklist.title: Quant candidate rejection accounting trail did not exist
unexpected_findings_beyond_the_checklist.detail: signal_lifecycle_summary.json explicitly states the rejection-stage breakdown was 'not separately queried' and would require an audit-trail table PIV does not use. candidates=1, published=0, but no rejected/pending/errored breakdown reconciled to that 1. Fixed in Task69Q Part 3 (decision_engine.py funnel accounting, see quant_funnel_contract.json).

unexpected_findings_beyond_the_checklist.title: Exit fill produced a second POSITION_OPENED event instead of POSITION_CLOSED
unexpected_findings_beyond_the_checklist.detail: Confirmed in raw piv_events.jsonl: event-type histogram shows POSITION_OPENED=4, POSITION_CLOSED=0 across the whole file. The 2026-08-25 probe's exit fill at 19:01:30.31Z produced a second POSITION_OPENED (different position_id, keyed by the exit order's own intent_id) rather than closing the entry's position record. Broker exposure was correct and flat throughout (not a financial bug) -- purely an event-log/state naming defect in PaperLifecycle.apply_broker_update, which keyed position identity by intent_id (unique per order) rather than by symbol-scoped open-position tracking.
unexpected_findings_beyond_the_checklist.fix_location: talonx_piv/lifecycle.py -- see production_readiness_gaps.json and this task's git log for the exact commit

unexpected_findings_beyond_the_checklist.title: piv_events.jsonl is a single append-only file spanning multiple trading dates with no session_id/trading_date field
unexpected_findings_beyond_the_checklist.detail: Confirmed: the file spans 2026-08-23 (5 events), 2026-08-24 (119 events), 2026-08-25 (85 events) in one unfiltered stream. eod_state.json itself flags this ('built_in_session_report_caveat') -- the derived latest_session_report.json counters are cumulative across days, not day-scoped, because the file is never rotated per session/date. Any per-day analysis (including Task69P's own summaries) required manual timestamp-prefix filtering with no built-in session boundary.
unexpected_findings_beyond_the_checklist.fix_location: talonx_piv/events.py (session_id/trading_date_et stamped on every event), talonx_piv/session_identity.py (canonical session identity), talonx_piv/reporting.py (trading_date_et-scoped report filtering)

unexpected_findings_beyond_the_checklist.title: /ping's headline Pipeline status was derived from an unrelated general-ingest subsystem, not PIV's own feed
unexpected_findings_beyond_the_checklist.detail: talonx_dispatch/telegram_listener.py's _pipeline_status() always read talonx_ingest's WS-heartbeat freshness, even for a PIV caller whose SessionRunner never writes to that heartbeat at all (it polls Alpaca's REST bars/latest directly). Task69P's own commit history (fix(dispatch): clarify /ping Pipeline/MARKET labels are ingest-pipeline-scoped) added an explanatory SUFFIX to the MARKET section body, but the headline verdict itself remained ingest-scoped and could read DEGRADED/Disconnected while PIV's actual Alpaca feed was healthy -- confirmed live per that commit's own note.
unexpected_findings_beyond_the_checklist.fix_location: talonx_dispatch/telegram_listener.py's _pipeline_status(), now PIV-aware via a live-updated piv_info['feed_health'] dict (talonx_piv/session_runner.py, talonx_piv/telegram_inbound.py)

unexpected_findings_beyond_the_checklist.title: Warmup provider (yfinance) vs live provider (Alpaca IEX) mismatch is a real, unresolved data-availability limitation
unexpected_findings_beyond_the_checklist.detail: 18 of 35 symbols failed warmup solely due to INSUFFICIENT_1M_HISTORY from yfinance, not from any strategy/session-readiness gate. This is the single largest driver of the 35->17->14 funnel narrowing. See warmup_provider_assessment.json for the Task69Q investigation into an Alpaca-historical alternative.

overall_assessment: Task69P's PASS/FAIL claims about broker lifecycle, reconciliation, and F6 non-integration are all independently reconfirmed and hold up under raw-evidence cross-check. The review surfaced four real gaps beyond the original checklist (U01-U04), all fixed as part of Task69Q, plus one data-availability limitation (U05) that is documented with a concrete remediation path but not fully resolved (requires verifying Alpaca historical entitlement in a live account context -- see warmup_provider_assessment.json).
